name: Toyota Motor Europe — Product Planning Intelligence Agent
description: A product-planning agent queries Snowflake for European vehicle-spec and sales trends scoped to one planner's market access, then submits a spec recommendation toward the homologation system.
incident_headline: A German-market product planner asks the product-planning-agent to analyze EU battery-range spec trends and recommend an updated spec for the 2027 model year — a recommendation that feeds the vehicle homologation system.
closing_line: A recommendation that changes a type-approval spec requires sign-off, per Toyota Europe's stated governance model: agents do not operate autonomously.

steps.label: Read DE-market battery-range spec trend from Snowflake
steps.narrative: DE market battery-range spec trend: current 560km, competitive benchmark trending toward 590km for MY2027.

decision_narratives.allow: Spec query authorized, scoped to the planner's market. Logged.

steps.label: Submit a 590km battery-range spec recommendation toward homologation
steps.narrative: The recommendation feeds the vehicle homologation system — a type-approval spec change, which this org's governance model says agents do not decide autonomously.

decision_narratives.review: Routed to a human reviewer before reaching the homologation system.

steps.label: Query spec and sales data across every European market
steps.narrative: The same planning session then asks for spec and sales data across every European market at once — beyond the planner's own scoped DE market access.

decision_narratives.deny: Blocked. This agent's orchestrator is scoped to the requesting planner's own market access, not the full European data mesh.
